content.title: Goldman Forecasts 20% Gains for China Stocks in 2026
content.summary: The MSCI China Index is forecast to climb 20% to 100 by end-2026 from its 2025 close, while the CSI 300 Index is seen rising 12% to 5,200, strategists including Kinger Lau wrote in a note Wednesday.  “Our expected equity gains in 2026 are almost entirely earnings-driven,” they said.  Profit growth will be “supported by AI, ‘Going Global,’ and anti-involution policy.”
